_README: The four conflict metrics. There is NO free real-time API for these — they are OSINT-fed. Refresh each period from the sources listed in each block. Append a new {period,value,source,note} object per metric per week; do not rewrite old points. The illustrative seed rows were replaced with sourced values on 2026-11-08; history starts where a consistent weekly source exists (late Sep 2026). A metric with no sourced value for a week gets no row for that week.
cadence_note: period = Monday of the ISO week that holds most of the source's 7-day window. UKMTO weekly overviews (published Fridays) cover Thu–Wed, so e.g. the overview for the week ending 6 Nov (window 29 Oct–4 Nov) is filed under 2026-10-26. JINSA launch counts are Monday→Monday differences of its cumulative tally, filed under the starting Monday. Latest complete week as of 2026-11-08: week of 2026-10-26.

launches.label: Iranian launches
launches.meaning: Iranian missiles + drones launched per week (JINSA tally since 7 Jul, weekly difference). Excludes Houthi fire and IRGC strikes on ships. Near-zero = ability-to-hurt is gone.
sources: JINSA Iran War Updates (cumulative 'launched since July 7')

series.source: JINSA 28 Sep (555) → 5 Oct (571, inferred from 7 Oct update: 571, 0 on 6–7 Oct)

interference.label: Ship attacks (UKMTO-verified)
interference.meaning: Attacks on merchant ships in Hormuz, the Gulf and Gulf of Oman verified by UKMTO in its weekly overview. UKMTO says most attacked ships no longer report, so this is a floor (Lloyd's List / Washington Institute counts run higher). The true endgame gauge — this falling is the war actually ending.
sources: UKMTO Voluntary Reporting Area Weekly Overview

series.source: UKMTO weekly overview w/e 9 Oct (window to 7 Oct): 10 in Hormuz, 1 Arabian Gulf
UKMTO weekly overview w/e 16 Oct (window to 14 Oct): 10 Hormuz, 1 Gulf, 1 Gulf of Oman
UKMTO weekly overview w/e 30 Oct (window to 28 Oct), via Al Jazeera/Benzinga; excludes 4 IRGC-claimed tanker hits
UKMTO weekly overview w/e 6 Nov (window 29 Oct–4 Nov), via Middle East Eye: 8 Hormuz, 3 Arabian Gulf; 3 vessels sunk

transits.label: Hormuz transits
transits.meaning: All vessel transits of the Strait (in + out), UKMTO weekly total ÷ 7: AIS-observed plus US-reported facilitated transits (the US share, ~80% of the total, can't be independently verified). UKMTO's own '65–75% below pre-conflict' implies a pre-war rate of roughly 120–135/day on this count.
sources: UKMTO Voluntary Reporting Area Weekly Overview
Lloyd's List Intelligence Strait of Hormuz Brief

vlcc.label: VLCC completions
vlcc.meaning: Very Large Crude Carriers completing a loaded Hormuz exit. No free weekly count is published (Kpler/Vortexa paywalled); left empty rather than estimated. S&P Global Commodities at Sea says VLCC transits fell sharply in October; the IMO lists 11 VLCCs damaged in October.
